d:
The best saves from Week 6 of the 2026-27 NHL season are here, featuring spectacular glove robberies, impossible desperation stops and some old-school goaltending.
Montreal rookie Jacob Fowler continues his impressive start with an unbelievable glove robbery on Cole Perfetti before coming up huge again against Auston Matthews. Connor Hellebuyck delivers in his New Jersey home debut with a clutch shootout stop on Kasperi Kapanen, while Colten Ellis desperately stretches out the right pad to rob Michael Amadio.
